summary: Verified the validate-no-task-references.sh whitespace-only regex gap (task-788/task_788/Task #788 all invisible; no Phase support), surveyed the literature extension's scripts/tests/ harness shape and its flat test-lit-pipeline.sh counterpart, and found an existing but differently-shaped core-scripts test precedent (test-task-lock-reap.sh). Confirmed lean-sorry-census.sh has a sound stripper+compiler-cross-check design but zero tests. Recommends shipping both tooling and a documented method, a scope-based (narrow vs. pipeline) test-harness-location rule, and including Phase references in the hook regex fix.
decisions_made: Deliverable shape: both shared executable tooling and a documented standard method (not either/or), per the binding testedness constraint.

Recommend agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/ for the new narrow, fixture-driven census test(s), following a scope-based split (narrow->tests/ subdir, broad/pipeline->flat) rather than blanket-copying either existing convention; treat as open to the planner's confirmation.
Recommend Phase references be brought in scope for the validate-no-task-references.sh regex fix alongside the separator/suffix fix.

Recommend the standard-method document live under context/standards/ (indexed, selectively loadable) rather than rules/ (auto-applied everywhere); flagged as a recommendation for planner confirmation, not a final decision.
